CPCB, Polluted River Stretches in India - October 2025 (Table 3.27 + Annexures II/III). Priority history from CPCB's 2018/2022/2025 assessments (2022 report via KSRRC mirror)

TNPCB Water Quality Status of Polluted River Stretches, monthly reports 2023 (tnpcb.gov.in, PR-Stretches page). Station points are town centroids (OSM Nominatim), PIP-validated against sub-basin polygons - TNPCB publishes no station coordinates. 4 of 19 mainstem stations (Urachikottai, R.N. Pudur, Vairapalayam, Thirumukkudal) could not be located confidently and are excluded from the map and counts; the total is stated in provenance. TNPCB's stretch-wise monthly water-quality reports end at December 2023 - this series is a closed archive, stated as such in the UI.
